name: Econergy Ltd
summary: Econergy Ltd, an independent power producing company, develops, owns, and operates utility-scale renewable energy projects in Italy, the United Kingdom, Romania, Spain, Poland, and Greece. It also operates solar, wind, and battery storage production sites. The company was formerly known as Econergy Renewable Energy Ltd and change its name to Econergy Ltd in April 2026. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Kfar Saba, Israel.
